reasoning: The package is a legitimate AUR wrapper for XnViewMP that uses system libraries. It downloads from the official xnview.com domain with pinned SHA-256 checksums, compiles a small ABI compatibility shim (qt5_std_fun_forwarder.so) to resolve Qt5 symbol versioning issues with modern libstdc++, and uses a standard launcher script with LD_PRELOAD. All files serve clear, documented packaging purposes. No code injection, no execution of fetched content, no fetching from unrelated hosts. The 'inconclusive' result from qwen3-235b was caused by HTTP 400 API errors on 4 of 8 files, not by security concerns.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement (inconclusive vs safe) was caused entirely by tooling failure in the qwen3-235b report, which received HTTP 400 BadRequestError responses when auditing .SRCINFO, XnView.desktop, gen_qt5_forwarders.sh, and qt5_std_fun_forwarder.S. The deepseek-v4-flash report successfully reviewed all 8 files and found them safe with detailed, accurate reasoning. The openrouter/free advisory report corroborates the safe verdict. There is no substantive security disagreement—only a coverage gap from API failures.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b report failed to audit 4 files (.SRCINFO, XnView.desktop, gen_qt5_forwarders.sh, qt5_std_fun_forwarder.S) due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in an inconclusive verdict despite the files it did review being safe
learnings: When an LLM API returns HTTP 400 errors for specific files, the audit tool should retry with a fallback model or queue those files for re-audit rather than propagating the failure to the final verdict as 'inconclusive'

The audit tool should distinguish between 'file reviewed and found safe' vs 'file could not be reviewed due to tool error' in the final verdict calculation—tool errors should trigger automatic re-audit of only the failed files rather than failing the entire package audit
Models should be prompted to explicitly flag when they cannot complete analysis of assigned files, so the orchestrator can route those files to alternative models without waiting for a full re-run
